summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **Petition No. 163/MP/2017** **Coram: Shri A.K. Singhal, Member Shri A.S. Bakshi, Member Dr. M. K. Iyer, Member** **Date of Order: 19** **th** **of January, 2018** # **In the matter of** Petition seeking a revision in the methodology for computing the Escalation Rates for domestic coal, as published by the Commission, for the purposes of payment of tariff with respect to a PPA under Case-I bidding process. # **And** # **In the matter of** Bharat Aluminium Company Limited Balco Nagar, Korba-495 684 ** .. Petitioner** **Versus** Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Ltd 10 th Floor, NPKRR Maaligai, 144, Anna Salai, Cheenai-600 002 Kerala State Electricity Board Limited Vyduthi Bhavanam, Pattom, Thiruvanathapuram, Kerala-695 004 ** Respondents** # **The following were present:** Shri Sanjay Sen, Senior Advocate, BALCO Shri Mutrugupta Mishra, Advocate, BALCO Shri Hemant Singh, Advocate, BALCO Shri Nishant Kumar, Advocate, BALCO Shri M.D.Zeyauddin, BALCO # ** ORDER ** Learned senior counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the present petition has been filed for seeking revision of methodology for computing the escalation rates Order in Petition No. 163/MP/2017 Page 1 for domestic coal, as published by the Commission, for the purposes of payment of tariff with respect to a PPA under Case-I bidding process. 2. Learned senior counsel for the Petitioner sought permission of the Commission to withdraw the present petition. 3. The prayer of the learned senior counsel of the Petitioner is allowed. Accordingly, Petition No. 163/MP/2017 is disposed of as withdrawn. Sd/sd/sd/- **(Dr. M. K. Iyer) (A. S. Bakshi) (A.K. Singhal) Member Member Member** Order in Petition No. 163/MP/2017 Page 2
